## Predicting ICU duration

Using the ICU cohort `mimiciv_icu_cohort.rds` you built in Homework 4, develop at least three machine learning approaches (logistic regression with enet regularization, random forest, boosting, SVM, MLP, etc) plus a model stacking approach for predicting whether a patient's ICU stay will be longer than 2 days. 
You should use the `los_long` variable as the outcome. 
Your algorithms can use patient demographic information (gender, age at ICU `intime`, marital status, race), ICU admission information (first care unit), the last lab measurements before the ICU stay, and first vital measurements during ICU stay as features. You are welcome to use any feature engineering techniques you think are appropriate; but make sure to not use features that are not available at an ICU stay's `intime`. For instance, `last_careunit` cannot be used in your algorithms. 

1. Data preprocessing and feature engineering.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(gtsummary)
library(tidymodels)
library(glmnet)
library(ranger)
library(keras)
```

```{r}
icu_cohort <- read_rds("~/203b-hw/hw4/mimiciv_shiny/mimic_icu_cohort.rds")
```

```{r}
# Define a function to check if the number of NA's in a column is greater than a threshold
drop_cols_with_nas <- function(data, threshold) {
  na_count <- sapply(data, function(col) sum(is.na(col)))
  return(data[, na_count <= threshold])
}

# Define a function to removes out-liers based on IQR
remove_outliers_iqr <- function(data_vector) {
  # Calculate the first and third quartiles (Q1, Q3) and the IQR
  quartiles <- quantile(data_vector, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr_value <- IQR(data_vector, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Replace out-liers with NA
  cleaned_vector <- dplyr::if_else(
    data_vector < quartiles[1] - 1.5 * iqr_value | 
    data_vector > quartiles[2] + 1.5 * iqr_value, 
    NA, 
    data_vector
  )
  # Return the vector with outliers replaced by NA
  return(cleaned_vector)
}



# Data preprocessing and feature engineering
mimic_icu_cohort <- icu_cohort |>
  
  # Select columns of interest
  select(subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id, los_long, first_careunit,
         marital_status, race, gender, age, 
         Sodium, Chloride, Creatinine, Potassium, Glucose, Hematocrit, 
         `White Blood Cells`, Bicarbonate,
         `Temperature Fahrenheit`, `Non Invasive Blood Pressure diastolic`, 
         `Respiratory Rate`, `Non Invasive Blood Pressure systolic`, 
         `Heart Rate`)|>
  
  # Impute NA's in marital_status with  category "OTHER".
  mutate(marital_status = replace(marital_status, 
                                  is.na(marital_status),
                                  "OTHER")) |>
  
  # Convert character and logical columns to factors
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor) |>
  mutate_if(is.logical, as.factor) |>
  
  # Drop columns with more than 9000 NA's
  drop_cols_with_nas(threshold = 9000) |>
  
  # Apply the remove_outliers_iqr function to numeric columns
  mutate_if(is.numeric, remove_outliers_iqr) |>
  
  # Impute NA's in numerical columns with the median
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), 
                ~if_else(is.na(.), 
                         median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))) |>
  print(width = Inf)
```


2. Partition data into 50% training set and 50% test set. Stratify partitioning according to `los_long`. For grading purpose, sort the data by `subject_id`, `hadm_id`, and `stay_id` and use the seed `203` for the initial data split. Below is the sample code.
```{r}
#| eval: false
set.seed(203)

# sort
mimiciv_icu_cohort <- mimic_icu_cohort |>
  arrange(subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id)|>
  select(-c(subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id))

data_split <- initial_split(
  mimiciv_icu_cohort, 
  # stratify by los_long
  strata = "los_long", 
  prop = 0.5
  )
```

```{r}
summary(mimiciv_icu_cohort)
```

```{r}
icu_train <- training(data_split)
dim(icu_train)
```
```{r}
icu_test <- testing(data_split)
dim(icu_test)
```

3. Train and tune the models using the training set.

### Logistic regression with enet regularization
```{r}
logit_recipe <- 
  recipe(
    los_long ~ ., 
    data = icu_train
  ) |>
  # create traditional dummy variables
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  # zero-variance filter
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) |> 
  # center and scale numeric data
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Models
logit_mod <- 
  logistic_reg(
    penalty = tune(), 
    mixture = tune()
  ) |> 
  set_engine("glmnet", standardize = FALSE) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Workflow
logit_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(logit_recipe) |>
  add_model(logit_mod) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Tuning grid
logit_param_grid <- grid_regular(
  penalty(range = c(-6, 3)), 
  mixture(),
  levels = c(100, 5)
  ) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
set.seed(203)

folds <- vfold_cv(icu_train, v = 5)
folds
```

```{r}
# Fit cross-validation (logistic)
(logit_fit <- logit_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = logit_param_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
    )) |>
  system.time()

logit_fit
```

```{r}
# Visualize CV results
logit_fit |>
  # aggregate metrics from K folds
  collect_metrics() |>
  print(width = Inf) |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = penalty, y = mean, color = factor(mixture))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Penalty", y = "CV AUC") +
  scale_x_log10()
```
```{r}
logit_fit |>
  show_best("roc_auc")
```

```{r}
best_logit <- logit_fit |>
  select_best("roc_auc")
best_logit
```

```{r}
# Final workflow
logit_final_wf <- logit_wf |>
  finalize_workflow(best_logit)
logit_final_wf
```

```{r}
# Fit the whole training set, then predict the test cases
logit_final_fit <- 
  logit_final_wf |>
  last_fit(data_split)
logit_final_fit
```
```{r}
# Test metrics
logit_final_fit |> 
  collect_metrics()
```

### Random forest

```{r}
rf_recipe <- 
  recipe(
    los_long ~ ., 
    data = icu_train
  ) |>
  # zero-variance filter
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Model
rf_mod <- 
  rand_forest(
    mode = "classification",
    # Number of predictors randomly sampled in each split
    mtry = tune(),
    # Number of trees in ensemble
    trees = tune()
  ) |> 
  set_engine("ranger") |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Workflow
rf_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(rf_recipe) |>
  add_model(rf_mod) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Tuning grid
rf_param_grid <- grid_regular(
  trees(range = c(400L, 600L)), 
  mtry(range = c(1L, 5L)),
  levels = c(3, 5)
  )|>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Fit cross-validation (random forest)
set.seed(203)
(rf_fit <- rf_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = rf_param_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
    )) |>
  system.time()

rf_fit
```

```{r}
# Visualize CV results
rf_fit |>
  collect_metrics() |>
  print(width = Inf) |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = trees, y = mean, color = factor(mtry))) +
  geom_point() + 
  labs(x = "Num. of Trees", y = "CV AUC")
```

```{r}
# Show the best 5 model
rf_fit |>
  show_best("roc_auc")
```

```{r}
# Select the best model
best_rf <- rf_fit |>

best_rf
```

```{r}
# Final workflow
rf_final_wf <- rf_wf |>
  finalize_workflow(best_rf)
rf_final_wf
```

```{r}
# Fit the whole training set, then predict the test cases
rf_final_fit <- 
  rf_final_wf |>
  last_fit(data_split)
rf_final_fit
```

```{r}
# Test metrics
rf_final_fit |> 
  collect_metrics()
```


### Multi-layer perceptron (MLP) 
```{r}
mlp_recipe <- 
  recipe(
    los_long ~ ., 
    data = icu_train
  ) |>
  # create traditional dummy variables (necessary for svm)
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  # zero-variance filter
  step_zv(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  # center and scale numeric data
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors()) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
# Model
mlp_mod <- 
  mlp(
    mode = "classification",
    hidden_units = tune(),
    dropout = tune(),
    epochs = 50,
  ) |> 
  set_engine("keras", verbose = 0)
mlp_mod
```

```{r}
mlp_wf <- workflow() |>
  add_recipe(mlp_recipe) |>
  add_model(mlp_mod)
mlp_wf
```

```{r}
mlp_param_grid <- grid_regular(
  hidden_units(range = c(5, 20)),
  dropout(range = c(0, 0.6)),
  levels = 4
  )
mlp_param_grid
```

```{r}
(mlp_fit <- mlp_wf |>
  tune_grid(
    resamples = folds,
    grid = mlp_param_grid,
    metrics = metric_set(roc_auc, accuracy)
    )) |>
  system.time()

mlp_fit
```

```{r}
mlp_fit |>
  collect_metrics() |>
  print(width = Inf) |>
  filter(.metric == "roc_auc") |>
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = dropout, y = mean, color = factor(hidden_units))) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(x = "Dropout Rate", y = "CV AUC") +
  scale_x_log10()
```

```{r}
# Show the best 5 model
mlp_fit |>
  show_best("roc_auc")
```

```{r}
# Select the best model
best_mlp <- mlp_fit |>

best_mlp
```

```{r}
# Final workflow
mlp_final_wf <- mlp_wf |>

mlp_final_wf
```

```{r}
# Fit the whole training set, then predict the test cases

  mlp_final_wf |>
  last_fit(data_split)
mlp_final_fit
```

```{r}

mlp_final_fit |> 
  collect_metrics()
```
